rows.text: Fiat currency is the problem. Companies, institutions, securities, and technologies that strengthen Bitcoin are part of the solution. We can debate ideas without mistaking allies for enemies.

Engineers at Coinbase are getting closer to recursive self-improvement, or loops.

For instance, agents can now ingest and summarize customer feedback collected right in the app, prioritize bugs and features based on that feedback, draft the code, security review it, and provide it to a human engineer for final review. All happens automatically each day and it learns from the human edits to improve over time.

We're finding more areas to introduce loops across the company. Instead of prompting agents with what to do, you can increasingly give them a goal, and they bring back high quality work for you to review.

Network School is not shutting down; that’s fake news.

We received two notices. The first tells us to change the text of a sign. The second says that our coworking site, which was created by joining two adjacent units, evidently has a valid license on the left hand side but not the right hand side.

We have a remedial period for both issues, and will remediate them shortly. But our members are otherwise unaffected.

Bitcoin ETFs Likely to Mirror Gold's History of Triumph and Pain.. New from me on how gold ETFs' 22-year history may offer the closest roadmap yet for Bitcoin ETF investors. Both are wrappers around non-yielding stores of value that generate no cash flow, leaving investor sentiment -- not earnings, coupons or government support, as with stocks and bonds -- to drive performance. GLD has experienced both extremes, briefly becoming the world's largest ETF before spending eight years in doldrums trying to get back to that place. Bitcoin ETFs may be following the same script: spectacular gains, painful drawdowns and recoveries that may test investors' patience. The good news tho: each cycle for gold ETFs has increased the high water mark. Two steps fwd one step back.

今天仍然要先夸 bitcoin:native ，在纳指每天都下跌 1% 以上的时候 Bitcoin 仍然保持在 64,000 美元，甚至今天是小幅上升的，这就说明随着资金从 AI 和半导体的撤出，已经有资金开始在注意 Bitcoin 了，这并不仅仅是购买力的提升，而且还是持仓者抛售的降低。

最近 Bitcoin 的操作仍然是围绕着双币进行的，62,000 美元的低价买入，而卖出调整到了下周二的 65,000 美元卖出，两边都是 20% 左右的权利金收入，周末价格的变化应该不会很大，主要是看下周了，而下周一也没有什么重要数据，周二下午 16 点就结束了，希望不会涨的太厉害，毕竟不是真想在 65,000 美元卖掉。

今天晚上的时候 82 美元的 WTI 和 86 美元的 Brant 都成交了，美国和伊朗的战争有继续升温的趋势，目前我的 WTI 的成本在 78.72 美元，Brant 的成本在 82.9 美元，对于战争来看，我仍然坚持自己的判断，美国和伊朗虽然重新交火，但都非常的克制，避免了战争在区域外的全面失控。

但这种情况双方把握的度确实越来越难，刚刚伊朗最高领袖顾问雷扎伊表示，若美国未来两三天持续发动攻击，伊朗将结束此前的威慑与对等反击策略，转向全面进攻与摧毁阶段，并称伊朗此前克制是为避免地区冲突外溢，而美国的攻击也并没有非常的犀利，双方都在等一个台阶。

继续的战争对双方都没有好处，所以我个人的感觉目前的战争对于油价的影响应该是有限度的，尤其是 Brant 和 WTI 的差价扩大到了 6 美元以上，现在相对 WTI 来说，做空 Brant 的效果应该更好。

周末看看川普会说什么吧。
